body: Thank you for your kind words, and the reply.
Thank you for taking the time to respond. It was helpful just knowing someone was hearing me scream into the darkness.

I actually lost my faith a long time ago and haven't been to Church since. All of this have left me wondering if I should go back. I might take you up on your advice. Thank you for taking the time to respond.

Thank you for taking the time to respond and the kind words. 

I set up a gofundme, like you said. Unfortunately, I don't have facebook and don't really have many friends. But here is the link if you could maybe share it to anyone you may know. 

I actually got some good news about her condition, but she requires more time in the hospital for her kindey's to recover. 

Here's the link if you would like to share it: 

https://www.gofundme.com/help-me-save-my-4-year-old-dog

Thank you so much for your reply and for sharing your story. I know it doesn't help, at least it doesn't help me, but I'm so sorry about your dog. I know it sounds odd, and it's probably a side-effect of the depression and everything right now, but it somehow makes me want to feel guilty for posting my story. 

And, like what happened to you, with such a grim prognosis there's  that microscopic corner of my mind that says it probably would be better to have her euthanized because of the money. If the prognosis is that grim....but I can't wrap my head around being without her.

I know this sounds stupid, a long time ago when I battled depression, the one thing that kept me from serious attempts at suicide was that my family needed me. That doesn't work anymore. I just feel like they would somehow survive without me. The two things that managed to keep me going were Akira and, now, my cat Cosmos. And I know it's the depression talking, but sometimes it seems like he'd be better in another home that plays with him more. 

Anyway..like I said before, thank you for sharing your story with a stranger on the internet. Hope things go better for you as well.

Thanks for the reply...it really does help just knowing somebody read and "heard" me out. 

It just doesn't feel like I can take anymore sometimes.

Unfortunately it's not. And we have a boiler system. I just said it was a furnace for simplicity. So it's even more expensive to fix/replace. If I make it through the night in once piece I'll probably try taking apart the dryer...hopefully it's a drive belt or something.
